name: Motion Lite
tagline: Animated captions for talking-head videos: Anna's AI transcribes and writes them, you tweak, your device exports the MP4.
description:
Motion Lite turns a short talking-head video (up to 60 seconds) into a captioned clip ready for Reels, TikTok or Shorts.

1. Choose a video. It stays on your device; only its speech is sent for transcription.
2. Motion Lite finds where you speak, transcribes each part, and the AI splits it into short punchy captions, picks the word to highlight and writes a headline.
3. Pick a look (Pop, Karaoke or Duo), fix any word, change the headline, and watch the preview.
4. Export: your own device renders the MP4 with the captions and the original sound (about the video's length on a mid-range phone).

Fully connected to the Anna host: speech-to-text and the AI captions run through Anna on your Anna credits, with no other account or key. Want cuts, motion graphics and styles copied from other videos? The full editor is at motion.glianalabs.com.
